name: Pervy Otryad
source:
What if you ended up in the Sovyonok camp not as a camp resident, but as a camp counselor?
This story will tell of a guy named Artyom, who once worked in the field of children's recreation but decided to leave it behind.
However, fate decided otherwise...

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2932961471]Steam[/url]]
